composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Design a square stained-glass panel centered on a slender heron standing among two curved reeds. Its body uses honey and ivory glass, while the surrounding water shapes use petrol blue, pale aqua, and muted green. Lead lines should follow the bird anatomy and reed curves rather than form a random patchwork. Include subtle bubbles, ripples, and varied translucency inside selected glass pieces. Let the panel fill most of the square without a heavy outer frame. The heron remains a clear central silhouette, with its long neck folded into a gentle S. Backlight the glass softly, preserving detail in the darker sections. No lettering, crest, or borrowed symbolic emblem.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
